scope: Finite synthetic learned four-modality generation with depth control and recursive NDU-conditioned generator fine-tuning. Not native Rust DecisionCell integration, learned identifiable preference, general FBSDE, or an open-domain foundation model.

joint_training.anchor: mean normalized vertex reconstruction loss across depths0..3
joint_training.updated: initial latent, shared refinement, all four decoders
joint_training.objective: negative calibration-marginal mean initial recursive utility at budget12, gamma2, P0=0; same terminal external loss as evaluation
joint_training.policy: reselect finite exact policy each update; differentiate that selected policy with identical loss tensor
joint_training.gradient_boundary: piecewise pathwise derivative; hard argmin contradiction is locally constant away ties, clamping and action ties are nonsmooth; no global convergence claim
joint_training.gradient_evidence: first and last update: separate NDU-utility and anchor gradient norms by parameter group; committed policy depth distribution under calibration; parameter movement alone does not prove NDU credit

costs.unit: declared proxy units, not physical FLOPs

preference: same bounded observed-disagreement update as v1.1; not learned latent preference identification
external_loss: unchanged metrics.score_outputs: mean per-modality normalized raw reconstruction error clipped at2, plus0.25 cross-modal nearest-prototype disagreement
static_selection: for each model and budget, validation selects a fixed acquisition subset/quarter-grid weights and fixed depth0..3 on mean external loss+0.5CVaR90; every acquisition and generation event is charged
selection: gamma fixed2, no heldout tuning; validation-only static policies saved before heldout generation

primary.endpoint: mean across seeds of within-seed CVaR90 external loss differences
primary.bootstrap: 1000 paired hierarchical draws, seeds then within-seed worlds
gates: mean ideal dense Linear MAC ratio<=1.05
all mandatory outputs and no budget violation

secondary: joint_ndu minus supervised_ndu compares NDU-conditioned parameter update with matched supervised updates
joint_ndu minus joint_static isolates dynamic control
joint_ndu minus joint_myopic probes continuation effect
joint_ndu minus joint_fixed_risk probes bounded preference effect
joint_ndu minus joint_risk_neutral probes risk profile
evidence_rules: no pooling v1/v1.1/v2 as independent seeds
no test-set policy or checkpoint selection
same concept space across splits, independent draws only
actual encoder calls lazy at heldout
offline table/DP and training costs reported
controller/generation modeled overhead in feasibility plus measured wall/CPU and ideal Linear MAC separately
new protocol required for changes after heldout inspection

execution_gates.local: real CPU execution with pinned dependencies and source hashes
execution_gates.hosted: GitHub-hosted CPU verification is distinct from dedicated execution
execution_gates.dedicated: external Actions job must attest runner desktop in group trillionnium-android-gpu with nonzero runner id and executed steps

preregistration_amendment.timing: before any v2 development training or heldout generation
preregistration_amendment.reason: independent review identified unequal optimizer-update budgets; add a matched supervised fine-tuning baseline without changing primary endpoint or thresholds

matched_supervised_training.initial_checkpoint: identical 100-step depth-supervised warmup as joint arm
matched_supervised_training.objective: mean across depths and portfolios of q-weighted normalized raw reconstruction MSE, plus the same vertex anchor; equivalent up to a parameter-independent constant to convex-target reconstruction
matched_supervised_training.matched: 40 optimizer updates; same grid+8-vertex forward examples, same four depths, same dense Linear forward MACs
matched_supervised_training.not_matched: joint adds policy compilation and recursive backward arithmetic; wall/CPU and lifetime costs reported separately
